items.difficulty_reason: The theorem states that two topologies on a category are equal if and only if they have the same sheaves (statement lines 11951-11961). The proof is a complete argument: one direction is immediate (proof lines 11964-11965); for the converse the author uses that covering sieves are characterised by the sheafification functor (proof lines 11965-11967), that the sheafification functor is the left adjoint of the inclusion of the category of sheaves (proof lines 11967-11970), so that equality of the categories of sheaves forces equality of the sheafification functors and hence of the covering sieves (proof lines 11971-11975). The non-formal content is the two-step characterisation. The claim is H1/H2: a short but complete argument with each input named.
